measurement_basis.workload: real SWE-Verified fixed32 Tail6 B1 Nsight attribution
measurement_basis.note: The trace predates the current conv-remap, direct-leaf-commit, and GDN dead-I/O patches; FA2 geometry is still the pinned 64x64 four-warp kernel.

candidate.scope: B1, params.d=256, params.h=24, noncausal, full-window, no ALiBi, no appended KV, tree_bias=32x32, seqlen_q=32, num_splits<=1
candidate.numerical_mechanism: Each CTA owns complete query rows and traverses the full ordered K-block loop. There is no executed KV split, output combine, or changed num_splits value. Warp-local row and lane coordinates match the stock tile for all 32 real rows. AllowSplit=false discards the 128-thread combine block for the one-warp traits; BOOL_SWITCH still compiles the Split=true main-kernel variant, while the runtime num_splits<=1 predicate prevents its execution. A static assertion fixes kGmemRowsPerThread=16, matching the public FA2 API invariant that paged-KV blocks are divisible by 16.
candidate.performance_risk: Each head rereads K/V in two query CTAs. The doubled KV traffic can offset the occupancy and masked-row gains at long contexts.
